answer: If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a horizon counter-signature, and the karst graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 19% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, entered as a pearl edge. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
